image_description: A close-up portrait of an orangutan's face and upper shoulders. The subject has characteristic reddish-brown shaggy fur, a broad flat face with dark skin, and forward-facing amber/brown eyes. The framing is tight, cutting off the top of the head and the lower body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Broad flat face with prominent cheek pads in mature males.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The face is broad and flat, but lacks the prominent, swollen cheek pads (flanges) typical of mature dominant males. This suggests the subject is a female or immature male.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dark brown eyes with forward-facing binocular vision.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes are clearly visible, dark/amber in color, and positioned for forward-facing binocular vision.
Ears are small and partially obscured by fur, consistent with species anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large body with tall, substantial proportions when standing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight close-up; the full body proportions and standing height cannot be verified.
Fur texture is long, shaggy, and reddish-brown, matching the description perfectly.
The chest area is largely out of frame or obscured by the angle; cannot confirm barrel shape.
The rear of the animal is not visible in this portrait crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Extremely long arms with exceptionally broad wingspan adapted for brachiation.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Arms are not visible in this head-and-shoulders shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long-fingered hands with opposable thumbs and big toes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Hands and feet are completely outside the frame.

artifact_observations.location: Facial skin around nose and mouth
artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like compared to the high-detail fur, lacking the fine pore structure expected in a macro shot, though it may be due to lighting/style.
Slight softness/bleeding at the boundary between the fur and the background, typical of AI generation or aggressive depth-of-field simulation.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' quality of the skin on the nose and muzzle. While the fur looks good, AI often struggles with the transition from hair to bare skin on primates. Check if the eye reflections are consistent with a single light source.
